comments: CyfrowyLead performs automated checks of one publicly accessible URL in a 1280×720 Chromium viewport using axe-core 4.13.0. Results reflect the observed rendered state. Passed tests do not establish full WCAG conformance. Incomplete results and cross-origin iframe coverage require manual review. The Accessibility Score is an internal indicator, not a WCAG conformance percentage. The tool does not test authenticated content, entire websites, keyboard flows, media accessibility or cross-origin iframe content.
features: CyfrowyLead is a free online checker for a single public web page. It renders the page in Chromium and uses axe-core to report automatically detected issues, passed and inapplicable rules, and items requiring review for WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 Levels A and AA. It also provides repair guidance and an internal accessibility score.
title: CyfrowyLead – Audyt WCAG
